items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: A16z-Backed OpenReserve Gets Approval for Full-Service National Bank
items.summary: The a16z-backed startup chose a full national charter over the trust-bank route most crypto firms have taken, clearing a path toward insured deposits and conventional lending alongside stablecoin issuance.

items.title: FinCEN Ties $12.7B to Crypto Scams Run From Asian Compounds
items.summary: Monthly reported sums rose 18% on average, and the compounds now appear to be spreading beyond Southeast Asia.

items.title: Revolut Says OCC Conditionally Approved Proposed US National Bank
items.summary: The fintech says it still needs FDIC, Federal Reserve and final OCC clearances before a planned 2027 launch offering insured deposits, credit and crypto access.

items.title: Tether Froze $42.4 Million Three Months Before A Seizure Warrant, Lawsuit Says
items.summary: Two Thai businessmen are suing Tether in Manhattan federal court over 42,417,785.62 USDT blacklisted across 10 Ethereum addresses.

items.title: CFTC Asks Judge to Dismiss CME Lawsuit Over Crypto Perpetual Futures
items.summary: The regulator argues that CME cannot challenge its approval of Kalshi’s Bitcoin perpetual contract without showing concrete financial harm.

items.title: SoFi Links Banking Network and Stablecoin to Kraken in New Deal
items.summary: Kraken will list SoFiUSD and gain access to SoFi’s round-the-clock dollar settlement network, while Kraken Prime will execute trades for SoFi’s crypto customers.

items.title: SEC Proposes Transfer Agent Rules for Blockchain-Based Share Records
items.summary: The proposal would update electronic recordkeeping rules and add risk-management and compliance requirements for registered transfer agents using blockchain systems.

items.title: BitMine’s Staked ETH Holds at 5.07 Million as Treasury Grows
items.summary: The $12.7 billion staked balance was unchanged in four weekly readings, while BitMine added 53,501 ETH and reported $335 million in annualized staking revenue.

items.title: CME Launches Crypto Index That Excludes Bitcoin and Ether
items.summary: The 10-asset emerging benchmark is free-float market-cap weighted, with real-time pricing and London, New York and Asia-Pacific settlement variants.

items.title: 39 State Banking Groups Form BankChain Alliance for 2027 Blockchain Launch
items.summary: The industry-owned network is still selecting a technology partner and would support tokenized deposits, stablecoins, smart payments and automated settlement.

items.title: Bitcoin Posts Biggest Week Since 2024 as Trump Pushes Senate on CLARITY Act
items.summary: Bitcoin gained 22.6% over seven days, its largest advance over any seven-day window since November 2024, after the president told crypto executives at the White House that Congress needs to pass market structure legislation.

items.title: HSBC and Standard Chartered Complete First Live Transaction on Swift Blockchain Ledger
items.summary: Swift’s ledger matched and netted obligations recorded on the banks’ separate platforms, but final settlement still ran through existing systems.

items.title: Gnosis Chain to Abandon Its Validator Set and Settle to Ethereum
items.summary: GnosisDAO approved a strategic shift from standalone Layer 1 to an Ethereum-settled rollup, unlocking about 350,000 GNO and ending treasury-funded staking rewards.

items.title: Tenev Pushes for Tokenized Stocks in America
items.summary: The Robinhood CEO published a case for US equity tokenization five days after the SEC shelved its innovation exemption for a second time.

items.title: SEC Proposes Token Offering Rules With $75 Million Exemption
items.summary: The proposal pairs two registration exemptions with a conditional safe harbor that would take the "investment contract" label off a token, and preempts state securities law.

items.title: SEC Proposes New Regulation Crypto Assets
items.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission today announced that it proposed new rules, titled “Regulation Crypto Assets,” that would create a clear and fit-for-purpose framework for certain investment contracts involving crypto assets.

items.summary: Crypto majors are mostly flat ahead of today’s supreme court opinion on the trump tariffs; btc +1% at $90,300; eth 13% at $3,090, sol +3% at $138; xrp +1% to $2.10.
